title: Iraqi Man Rescued from Insurgents
description: An Iraqi citizen, who wishes to be unidentified, shows bruises on his body inflicted by foreign fighters in an insurgent safe house, where he was taken hostage, tortured, and beaten. US Marines and Iraqi security forces rescued the man from Ubaydi. The man talks about his capture to interviewer (english translation is heard off-camera)  Video by 2nd Marine Expeditionary Force Public Affairs.
